title: Current-Term Pay-Off on the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy: Terms and Customer Payment Tool
content:
**Terms.** A named insured on the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy may pay off the current term in one payment recorded against the current term, and a term paid off in full receives no further installment bill.

## When the pay-off amount is fixed

The pay-off amount is not fixed until every billed installment of the current term other than installment 1 carries its installment fee on the premium account.

The pay-off amount is fixed only after each returned payment posted on the policy carries its returned-payment fee entry.

The pay-off amount is not fixed until the premium account carries a late fee for every installment still unpaid more than the grace days after its due date.

## Situation of use and capability

`pay_off_term_premium_a09f99f1` pays off the current term of one LandlordGuard dwelling policy in a single payment by the named insured. One call records one premium payment from the insured against the current term, lowers the policy's premium balance by the amount paid and issues a payment confirmation number; the payment and its confirmation number are then visible on the premium account.

## How it is invoked

This is the customer's own tool. The representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`, naming `pay_off_term_premium_a09f99f1`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `dwelling_policy_id` | the reference id of the landlord dwelling policy record being paid, as given to the insured by the representative from the dwelling policy lookup | identifier |
| `amount` | the payment amount in USD | positive amount to 2 decimal places; a value with more places is rounded half-up to 2 decimal places when recorded |
| `payment_method` | how the insured pays | one of `eft` (bank account by electronic funds transfer), `card` (debit or credit card), `check` (a personal check mailed or handed over), `mortgagee_check` (the mortgage lender pays from escrow by its own check), `none` (no payment method applies, which never fits a payment the insured makes) |

The current term is taken from the policy itself; it is not a parameter.

## Return

A one-line receipt: "Pay-off received: entry <entry_id>, confirmation <payment_reference>, <amount> USD by <payment_method> for the current term starting <term_effective_date>, posted <posted_date>." The entry id is the new premium-ledger entry, the confirmation is the number issued for this payment, the amount is shown to 2 decimal places, the method is echoed, and the term start and posted date are YYYY-MM-DD. Receiving this line means the pay-off is recorded.
